packageRules.description: Base image 'ubuntu' is intentionally a floating '24.04' tag (always pulls the newest 24.04 at build time), so no update PRs for now. Do NOT re-enable with plain semver: that would jump to non-LTS releases like 24.10. When we later pin it, use ubuntu versioning restricted to LTS.

UPDATE LEVEL (single place) for all tracked images and Dockerfile packages. NOTE: matchUpdateTypes lists the update types to BLOCK (enabled=false), not to allow. Current = MINOR level: block ["major"] => minor + patch stay enabled and collapse into ONE PR at the highest allowed version. PATCH level: block ["major", "minor"] AND add top-level "separateMinorPatch": true (so a patch still gets a PR when a now-blocked minor exists). MAJOR level (allow everything): delete this whole rule.

Regex filter for used LTS. PowerShell is pinned to the current LTS minor line 7.6.x -> patch updates only. PowerShell uses EVEN minors for LTS (7.4, 7.6, ...) and ODD minors for STS (7.5, 7.7, ...); this allowedVersions blocks any move off 7.6, so no STS like 7.5.x/7.7.x. Bump this range by hand when adopting the next LTS (e.g. 7.8).

customManagers.description: DOCKERFILE-ARG packages: track versions pinned via 'ARG <NAME>_VERSION' with a 'renovate:' comment above them
IMAGES: update cr.vidinet.net image tags annotated with a 'renovate:' comment above the 'tag:' line
